main.description: Whether the caller has accepted the beta terms in force. The dashboard asks after each sign-in and shows the terms until the caller accepts them with acceptTerms: once per account, and again whenever the terms change. createInstance is refused until then. Customers and staff; anyone else is refused.

termsVersion.description: The beta terms in force, e.g. beta-2026-11. Bumped whenever the Terms of Service change.

accepted.description: Whether the caller has accepted termsVersion for their account.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is neither a customer nor staff, or the provisioner refused them.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The provisioner refused the request as malformed. Not expected from this read; declared because every provisioner refusal is mapped the same way.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The provisioner is unreachable, not configured, or answered with an error it does not explain to callers.
